com.esignal.jstandard.beans.news

Interface NewsRequest

  • All Superinterfaces:
    TurnAroundAware
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultNewsRequest

    public interface NewsRequest
extends TurnAroundAware
    Purpose of this class is to hold request parameters before giving it to News server.

    The client needs to set a unique turnaround for every request along with a request query.

    Since:
    01-019-0000
    Author:
    Interactive Data
    See Also:
    DefaultNewsRequest

      • isSubscribeAllActions

        boolean isSubscribeAllActions()
        Get the flag that will dictate whether the request will subscribe to all headline update actions, see NewsRequest.NEWS_ACTION Note : When this flag is set, it implies that you are making a subscription call. This flag will be ignored for the News request and will be honored for the subscribe calls only.
        Returns:
        allActions.
